fields.label: Control Key Type
fields.source: Digital Dealer — Your DMS and Schedules; GM Dealer Standard Accounting Manual
fields.notes: Per the task brief, this is the priority payload for this entity: each schedule type keys its open items differently. Warranty claims receivable keys on RO#/claim#; new vehicle floor plan keys on stock#/VIN-last-8; factory receivables key on claim/program ref; contracts in transit key on deal/contract#; service/parts WIP keys on RO#. Per ALIGNMENT_BRIEF.md: the schedule control key is the assignment/reference field family on the open-item line -- BSEG-ZUONR (assignment number) is the primary candidate; BSEG-XBLNR (reference document number) and BSEG-AUFNR (order number, when the control key is an RO number) are the alternates depending on control_key_type. ZUONR chosen as the default because it is the field SAP itself uses as the generic open-item sort/matching key regardless of what business object it encodes.

fields.label: Control Key Value

See also BSEG-XBLNR / BSEG-AUFNR as alternates when control_key_type is REFERENCE_DOC_NUMBER or RO_NUMBER respectively.

fields.label: Part Number
fields.source: Karmak — PACCAR Integration (OEM parts invoice import, compared to POs/receipts)
fields.notes: Material ordered on this PO line, consistent with the part master mapping used elsewhere (MARA-MATNR).

widening.reason: SAP EKPO-MATNR is CHAR(18); the CDK/dealer-native value for this field can genuinely run up to 20 characters. Per docs/model/WIDENING-POLICY.md, the spine keeps SAP semantics (this field IS the SAP analogue conceptually) but emits the source-native width (20) in DDL rather than truncating real dealer data to fit a legacy SAP field length.

fields.label: Quantity Ordered
fields.notes: PO line quantity ordered.

fields.label: Quantity Received
fields.source: Karmak — PACCAR Integration (electronic ASN/packing slip used to receive parts)
fields.notes: Goods-receipt quantity is recorded on the material document line (MSEG), not the PO line itself -- MSEG is defined in the canon at schema/sap-modules/mm/tables/MSEG.yaml.

fields.label: Receipt (GR) Document Number
fields.notes: Material document header number -- MKPF (Material Document Header) is defined in the canon.

widening.reason: SAP MKPF-MBLNR is CHAR(10); the CDK/dealer-native value for this field can genuinely run up to 20 characters. Per docs/model/WIDENING-POLICY.md, the spine keeps SAP semantics (this field IS the SAP analogue conceptually) but emits the source-native width (20) in DDL rather than truncating real dealer data to fit a legacy SAP field length.

fields.label: Receipt Date
fields.notes: Posting date of the goods receipt material document.

fields.label: Advance Ship Notice (ASN) Number
fields.source: Karmak — PACCAR Integration (electronic ASN/packing slips used to receive parts)
fields.notes: PACCAR OEM parts flow uses electronic ASN/packing slips for receiving, per Karmak's documented dealer-DMS integration; this is the clearest DOCUMENTED-adjacent fact available for this NONE-reach entity, though the field itself remains INFERRED since no field-level schema was published. Advance Shipping Notice number is an EDI/logistics concept carried informally (often in a text or reference field) rather than a dedicated structural field on EKKO/EKPO/MKPF/MSEG in this canon -- MKPF-XBLNR (reference document number) is the closest free-text landing spot but is not a structurally dedicated ASN field, so this is declared absent rather than forced.

fields.label: Vendor Invoice Number
fields.source: Karmak — PACCAR Integration (OEM parts invoices imported, compared to POs/receipts, auto-posted to AP)
fields.notes: Vendor invoice matching in SAP lives on RBKP/RSEG (Logistics Invoice Verification), neither of which is inventoried in this canon yet. Declared absent rather than pointed at an undefined table pair; see schema/mapping/crosswalk_gaps.md for the RBKP/RSEG gap.

fields.label: Unit Cost (Invoiced)
fields.notes: Net price per unit on the PO line.

fields.label: Three-Way Match Status

enum_values.meaning: PO, receipt, and invoice all agree
Quantity variance between receipt and invoice
Price variance between PO and invoice

fields.source: Standard ERP three-way-match convention; Karmak's PACCAR integration explicitly supports automated three-way matching for OEM parts invoices
fields.notes: Three-way-match (PO/receipt/invoice) status is a derived workflow state computed across EKKO/EKPO/MSEG/RBKP at query or batch-job time in real SAP (e.g. via MM 'blocked invoice' logic), not a single stored field. Declared absent.

fields.label: AP Posting GL Account
fields.source: Standard ERP convention (auto-post to AP after three-way match)
fields.notes: MSEG carries the GL account the goods movement postings hit (SAKTO) for movements with direct account assignment -- the closest structural analogue to an AP posting account captured at receipt time.

fields.label: Movement Type (SAP Analogue)
fields.source: Proposed SAP mapping: Movement Type 101 (Goods Receipt against PO)
fields.notes: This is a proposed cross-system mapping for the digital-twin exercise, not a confirmed CDK-native field.

widening.reason: SAP MSEG-BWART is CHAR(3); the CDK/dealer-native value for this field can genuinely run up to 4 characters. Per docs/model/WIDENING-POLICY.md, the spine keeps SAP semantics (this field IS the SAP analogue conceptually) but emits the source-native width (4) in DDL rather than truncating real dealer data to fit a legacy SAP field length.
